title: Catalog seek configuration update
statement: Given a finite-tape configuration in a seeking phase, a tape index $i$, a seeking phase $q$, and an integer $z$, form a new configuration by setting its state to $q$ and adding $z$ to the head position on tape $i$. All other configuration data and all other tape-head positions remain unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A configuration whose state set is the four seeking phases
